spec.label: R-I043-4
spec.notes: Symptom: at the parent (2eff8f9), candidate filtering and the lock gap use abstract statuses only. Game 200 is abstract 'P' but detailed 'Postponed', so the parent's select_pick keeps Kwan as a candidate, and _lock_decision_from_predictions (bts.picks.get_game_statuses, patched {100: 'P', 200: 'P'}) counts Kwan's projected 0.80 against the confirmed Díaz 0.82. The 0.02 gap is under early_lock_gap 0.03, so should_lock returns False and `assert result["should_post"] is True` fails (line 515 at 0799bf2, unique). Static checks against git show 2eff8f9:src/bts/...: bts.scheduler.check_confirmed_lineups, bts.orchestrator.run_cascade, bts.picks.get_game_statuses_detailed, bts.picks.get_game_statuses, bts.strategy.get_game_statuses and bts.strategy._load_mdp exist, and run_single_check keeps its signature. tmp_path holds no pick, so the parent's classify_pick_lock_state is never reached. should_lock at the parent is the confirmed-versus-best-projected gap rule. test_default_coarse_path_does_not_lookup_detailed_status passes at both (no existing pick, so the detailed lookup is never made). Not selected: the three new detailed-filter select_pick tests (they pass game_statuses_detailed=, added by this fix, so TypeError at the parent) and tests/test_picks.py (a module-level import of pick_candidate_status_is_available, added by this fix, so a collection error at the parent).
